class LSCPrunedLoRALinear(nn.Module):
    # LSC-FIX-07: this is a linear layer, not an attention module.
    is_custom_attention: bool = False
    is_custom_linear: bool = True

    def __init__(
        self,
        in_features: int,
        out_features: int,
        weight: torch.Tensor,
        bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        lora_r: int = 0,
        lora_alpha: float = 1.0,
        device: torch.device | None = None,
        dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.in_features = in_features
        self.out_features = out_features
        self.nf = out_features  # Conv1D compatibility
        self.lora_r = int(lora_r)
        self.lora_alpha = float(lora_alpha)
        self.scaling = (self.lora_alpha / self.lora_r) if self.lora_r > 0 else 1.0
        self.rank = self.lora_r  # Alias for detection

        target_device = device if device is not None else weight.device
        target_dtype = dtype if dtype is not None else weight.dtype

        self.weight = nn.Parameter(
            weight.to(device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype),
            requires_grad=False,
        )
        if bias is not None:
            self.bias = nn.Parameter(
                bias.to(device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype),
                requires_grad=False,
            )
        else:
            self.register_parameter("bias", None)

        if self.lora_r > 0:
            # LSC-FIX-03: LoRA parameters in base weight's dtype for forward consistency.
            self.lora_A = nn.Parameter(
                torch.empty((self.lora_r, in_features), dtype=target_dtype, device=target_device)
            )
            self.lora_B = nn.Parameter(
                torch.zeros(
                    (out_features, self.lora_r),
                    dtype=target_dtype,
                    device=target_device,
                )
            )
            nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.lora_A, a=math.sqrt(5))
        else:
            self.register_parameter("lora_A", None)
            self.register_parameter("lora_B", None)

    @classmethod
    def from_linear(
        cls,
        linear: nn.Module,
        weight: torch.Tensor,
        lora_r: int = 0,
        lora_alpha: float = 1.0,
    ) -> LSCPrunedLoRALinear:
        base_layer = getattr(linear, "base_layer", linear)
        bias = (
            base_layer.bias.detach()
            if hasattr(base_layer, "bias") and base_layer.bias is not None
            else None
        )
        in_features = getattr(base_layer, "in_features", weight.shape[1])
        out_features = getattr(base_layer, "out_features", weight.shape[0])

        existing_lora_r = _detect_lora_rank(linear)
        eff_lora_r = existing_lora_r if existing_lora_r > 0 else lora_r
        eff_lora_alpha = _detect_lora_alpha(linear) if existing_lora_r > 0 else lora_alpha

        layer = cls(
            in_features=in_features,
            out_features=out_features,
            weight=weight,
            bias=bias,
            lora_r=eff_lora_r,
            lora_alpha=eff_lora_alpha,
            device=weight.device,
            dtype=weight.dtype,
        )

        # Preserve existing LoRA if shapes match.
        if (
            hasattr(linear, "lora_A")
            and hasattr(linear, "lora_B")
            and layer.lora_A is not None
            and layer.lora_B is not None
        ):
            with torch.no_grad():
                src_A = getattr(linear.lora_A, "weight", linear.lora_A)
                src_B = getattr(linear.lora_B, "weight", linear.lora_B)
                if isinstance(src_A, torch.Tensor) and src_A.shape == layer.lora_A.shape:
                    layer.lora_A.data.copy_(src_A.to(layer.lora_A.device, dtype=layer.lora_A.dtype))
                if isinstance(src_B, torch.Tensor) and src_B.shape == layer.lora_B.shape:
                    layer.lora_B.data.copy_(src_B.to(layer.lora_B.device, dtype=layer.lora_B.dtype))

        if layer.lora_A is not None:
            layer.lora_A.requires_grad = True
        if layer.lora_B is not None:
            layer.lora_B.requires_grad = True

        return layer

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        out = F.linear(x, self.weight, self.bias)
        if self.lora_r > 0 and self.lora_A is not None and self.lora_B is not None:
            # Preserve dtype consistency: do the LoRA computation in the
            # base weight's dtype (input dtype may differ).
            lora_out = F.linear(F.linear(x, self.lora_A), self.lora_B)
            out = out + self.scaling * lora_out.to(out.dtype)
        return out

Base class for all neural network modules.

Your models should also subclass this class.

Modules can also contain other Modules, allowing them to be nested in a tree structure. You can assign the submodules as regular attributes::

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(1, 20, 5)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(20, 20, 5)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = F.relu(self.conv1(x))
        return F.relu(self.conv2(x))

Submodules assigned in this way will be registered, and will also have their parameters converted when you call :meth:to, etc.

Note

As per the example above, an __init__() call to the parent class must be made before assignment on the child.

:ivar training: Boolean represents whether this module is in training or evaluation mode. :vartype training: bool

Expand source code 
class LowRankCompressor(BaseCompressor):
    is_custom_attention: bool = True
    """
    SoKA Low-Rank Linear Compressor.
    Replaces dense nn.Linear and Conv1D layers with factorized LowRankLinear layers.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        rank: int = 8,
        energy_threshold: float | None = None,
        max_error: float = 0.5,
        target_attention_only: bool = False,
        fallback_to_original: bool = True,
        target_modules: list[str] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(model, name="soka", **kwargs)
        cfg = kwargs.get("comp_config", kwargs.get("cfg"))
        if cfg is not None:
            rank = _cfg_get(cfg, "soka_rank", _cfg_get(cfg, "rank", rank))
            energy_threshold = _cfg_get(
                cfg, "soka_energy", _cfg_get(cfg, "energy_threshold", energy_threshold)
            )
            max_error = _cfg_get(cfg, "max_error", max_error)
            fallback_to_original = _cfg_get(cfg, "fallback_to_original", fallback_to_original)
            target_attention_only = _cfg_get(cfg, "target_attention_only", target_attention_only)

        self.rank = max(1, int(rank))
        self.energy_threshold = energy_threshold
        self.max_error = float(max_error)
        self.target_attention_only = bool(target_attention_only)
        self.fallback_to_original = bool(fallback_to_original)
        self.target_modules = target_modules
        self.compressed_layers: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.layer_errors: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.stats: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        name_l = name.lower()
        if any(k in name_l for k in ["classifier", "score", "lm_head", "pooler", "embedding"]):
            return False

        if self.target_attention_only:
            attn_keywords = [
                "attn",
                "attention",
                "q_proj",
                "k_proj",
                "v_proj",
                "o_proj",
                "c_attn",
                "c_proj",
                "query",
                "key",
                "value",
            ]
            if not any(k in name_l for k in attn_keywords):
                return False

        base_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
        cls_name = base_mod.__class__.__name__
        is_linear_like = (
            isinstance(base_mod, nn.Linear)
            or "conv1d" in cls_name.lower()
            or hasattr(base_mod, "nf")
        )
        if not is_linear_like:
            return False
        if isinstance(base_mod, LowRankLinear):
            return False
        if not should_compress_linear(self.model, name):
            return False
        if self.target_modules is None:
            return True
        return any(t in name for t in self.target_modules)

    def _select_rank(self, S: torch.Tensor, in_f: int, out_f: int) -> int:
        """Determines rank dynamically based on singular energy or fixed target, capped for true reduction."""
        param_cap = max(1, (in_f * out_f) // (in_f + out_f) - 1)
        max_r = min(len(S), param_cap)

        if self.energy_threshold is None:
            return max(1, min(self.rank, max_r))
        total_energy = torch.sum(S**2)
        if total_energy <= 0:
            return max(1, min(self.rank, max_r))
        cum_energy = torch.cumsum(S**2, dim=0) / total_energy
        idx = torch.where(cum_energy >= self.energy_threshold)[0]
        r = idx[0].item() if len(idx) > 0 else len(S)
        return max(1, min(r, max_r))

    def compress(self, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
        """Replaces target Linear and Conv1D modules with LowRankLinear."""
        self.compressed_layers = []
        self.layer_errors = {}

        linear_layers: list[tuple[str, nn.Module]] = []
        for name, module in self.model.named_modules():
            if self._is_target_module(name, module):
                linear_layers.append((name, module))

        if not linear_layers:
            logger.warning("SoKA: No compressible linear layers found.")
            return self.model, self.get_compression_stats()

        for name, module in linear_layers:
            base_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
            raw_w = base_mod.weight.data
            cls_name = base_mod.__class__.__name__
            is_conv1d = (
                "conv1d" in cls_name.lower()
                or hasattr(base_mod, "nf")
                or (
                    raw_w.ndim == 2
                    and hasattr(base_mod, "in_features")
                    and base_mod.in_features == raw_w.shape[0]
                    and raw_w.shape[0] < raw_w.shape[1]
                )
            )

            W = raw_w.t().contiguous().clone().float() if is_conv1d else raw_w.clone().float()
            device = raw_w.device
            dtype = raw_w.dtype
            d_out, d_in = W.shape

            try:
                U, S, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False)
                r = self._select_rank(S, d_in, d_out)
                sqrt_S = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S[:r], min=1e-12))

                new_layer = LowRankLinear(
                    in_features=d_in,
                    out_features=d_out,
                    rank=r,
                    bias=(base_mod.bias is not None),
                    device=device,
                    dtype=dtype,
                )

                # Assign factorized weights: W ≈ (U_r sqrt(S)) @ (sqrt(S) V_r^T)
                # U: [d_out, r], V: [d_in, r]
                new_layer.U.data = (U[:, :r] * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0)).to(dtype=dtype, device=device)
                new_layer.V.data = (Vh[:r, :].T * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0)).to(
                    dtype=dtype, device=device
                )

                if base_mod.bias is not None:
                    new_layer.bias.data.copy_(base_mod.bias.data)

                # Frobenius reconstruction error check
                W_rec = new_layer.weight.float()
                norm_orig = torch.norm(W, p="fro")
                rel_err = (torch.norm(W - W_rec, p="fro") / (norm_orig + 1e-8)).item()
                self.layer_errors[name] = rel_err

                if self.fallback_to_original and rel_err > self.max_error:
                    logger.warning(
                        "SoKA reconstruction error %.4f on %s exceeded threshold %.4f. Skipping.",
                        rel_err,
                        name,
                        self.max_error,
                    )
                    for p in module.parameters():
                        p.requires_grad = False
                    continue

                compressed_layer = new_layer
                # Preserve existing LoRA adapter weights if the source module has them
                if (
                    hasattr(module, "lora_A")
                    and hasattr(module, "lora_B")
                    and module.lora_A is not None
                    and module.lora_B is not None
                ):
                    src_lA = getattr(module.lora_A, "weight", module.lora_A)
                    src_lB = getattr(module.lora_B, "weight", module.lora_B)
                    if hasattr(new_layer, "lora_A") and new_layer.lora_A is not None:
                        if hasattr(src_lA, "data") and src_lA.shape == new_layer.lora_A.shape:
                            new_layer.lora_A.data.copy_(src_lA.data)
                    if hasattr(new_layer, "lora_B") and new_layer.lora_B is not None:
                        if hasattr(src_lB, "data") and src_lB.shape == new_layer.lora_B.shape:
                            new_layer.lora_B.data.copy_(src_lB.data)

                if hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                    module.base_layer = compressed_layer  # put compressed layer inside wrapper
                    # module itself (LoRALinear wrapper) remains the replacement
                    new_module = module
                else:
                    new_module = compressed_layer
                if not hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                    if name == "":
                        self.model = new_module
                    else:
                        replace_module(self.model, name, new_module)
                self.compressed_layers.append(
                    {
                        "name": name,
                        "original_shape": (d_out, d_in),
                        "rank": r,
                        "error": rel_err,
                    }
                )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug("SVD decomposition error in %s: %s", name, e)
                for p in module.parameters():
                    p.requires_grad = False

        self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
        stats = self.get_compression_stats()
        stats.update(
            {
                "total_layers": len(self.compressed_layers),
                "method": "soka_low_rank_svd",
                "fixed_rank": self.rank,
                "energy_threshold": self.energy_threshold,
                "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
                "target_attention_only": self.target_attention_only,
                "fallback_to_original": self.fallback_to_original,
                "max_error": self.max_error,
            }
        )
        self.stats = stats
        return self.model, stats

                        new_layer.lora_A.data.copy_(src_lA.data)
                if hasattr(new_layer, "lora_B") and new_layer.lora_B is not None:
                    if hasattr(src_lB, "data") and src_lB.shape == new_layer.lora_B.shape:
                        new_layer.lora_B.data.copy_(src_lB.data)

            if hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                module.base_layer = compressed_layer  # put compressed layer inside wrapper
                # module itself (LoRALinear wrapper) remains the replacement
                new_module = module
            else:
                new_module = compressed_layer
            if not hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                if name == "":
                    self.model = new_module
                else:
                    replace_module(self.model, name, new_module)
            self.compressed_layers.append(
                {
                    "name": name,
                    "original_shape": (d_out, d_in),
                    "rank": r,
                    "error": rel_err,
                }
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug("SVD decomposition error in %s: %s", name, e)
            for p in module.parameters():
                p.requires_grad = False

    self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
    stats = self.get_compression_stats()
    stats.update(
        {
            "total_layers": len(self.compressed_layers),
            "method": "soka_low_rank_svd",
            "fixed_rank": self.rank,
            "energy_threshold": self.energy_threshold,
            "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
            "target_attention_only": self.target_attention_only,
            "fallback_to_original": self.fallback_to_original,
            "max_error": self.max_error,
        }
    )
    self.stats = stats
    return self.model, stats

class LowRankCompressor(BaseCompressor):
    is_custom_attention: bool = True
    """
    SoKA Low-Rank Linear Compressor.
    Replaces dense nn.Linear and Conv1D layers with factorized LowRankLinear layers.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        rank: int = 8,
        energy_threshold: float | None = None,
        max_error: float = 0.5,
        target_attention_only: bool = False,
        fallback_to_original: bool = True,
        target_modules: list[str] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(model, name="soka", **kwargs)
        cfg = kwargs.get("comp_config", kwargs.get("cfg"))
        if cfg is not None:
            rank = _cfg_get(cfg, "soka_rank", _cfg_get(cfg, "rank", rank))
            energy_threshold = _cfg_get(
                cfg, "soka_energy", _cfg_get(cfg, "energy_threshold", energy_threshold)
            )
            max_error = _cfg_get(cfg, "max_error", max_error)
            fallback_to_original = _cfg_get(cfg, "fallback_to_original", fallback_to_original)
            target_attention_only = _cfg_get(cfg, "target_attention_only", target_attention_only)

        self.rank = max(1, int(rank))
        self.energy_threshold = energy_threshold
        self.max_error = float(max_error)
        self.target_attention_only = bool(target_attention_only)
        self.fallback_to_original = bool(fallback_to_original)
        self.target_modules = target_modules
        self.compressed_layers: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.layer_errors: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.stats: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        name_l = name.lower()
        if any(k in name_l for k in ["classifier", "score", "lm_head", "pooler", "embedding"]):
            return False

        if self.target_attention_only:
            attn_keywords = [
                "attn",
                "attention",
                "q_proj",
                "k_proj",
                "v_proj",
                "o_proj",
                "c_attn",
                "c_proj",
                "query",
                "key",
                "value",
            ]
            if not any(k in name_l for k in attn_keywords):
                return False

        base_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
        cls_name = base_mod.__class__.__name__
        is_linear_like = (
            isinstance(base_mod, nn.Linear)
            or "conv1d" in cls_name.lower()
            or hasattr(base_mod, "nf")
        )
        if not is_linear_like:
            return False
        if isinstance(base_mod, LowRankLinear):
            return False
        if not should_compress_linear(self.model, name):
            return False
        if self.target_modules is None:
            return True
        return any(t in name for t in self.target_modules)

    def _select_rank(self, S: torch.Tensor, in_f: int, out_f: int) -> int:
        """Determines rank dynamically based on singular energy or fixed target, capped for true reduction."""
        param_cap = max(1, (in_f * out_f) // (in_f + out_f) - 1)
        max_r = min(len(S), param_cap)

        if self.energy_threshold is None:
            return max(1, min(self.rank, max_r))
        total_energy = torch.sum(S**2)
        if total_energy <= 0:
            return max(1, min(self.rank, max_r))
        cum_energy = torch.cumsum(S**2, dim=0) / total_energy
        idx = torch.where(cum_energy >= self.energy_threshold)[0]
        r = idx[0].item() if len(idx) > 0 else len(S)
        return max(1, min(r, max_r))

    def compress(self, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
        """Replaces target Linear and Conv1D modules with LowRankLinear."""
        self.compressed_layers = []
        self.layer_errors = {}

        linear_layers: list[tuple[str, nn.Module]] = []
        for name, module in self.model.named_modules():
            if self._is_target_module(name, module):
                linear_layers.append((name, module))

        if not linear_layers:
            logger.warning("SoKA: No compressible linear layers found.")
            return self.model, self.get_compression_stats()

        for name, module in linear_layers:
            base_mod = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
            raw_w = base_mod.weight.data
            cls_name = base_mod.__class__.__name__
            is_conv1d = (
                "conv1d" in cls_name.lower()
                or hasattr(base_mod, "nf")
                or (
                    raw_w.ndim == 2
                    and hasattr(base_mod, "in_features")
                    and base_mod.in_features == raw_w.shape[0]
                    and raw_w.shape[0] < raw_w.shape[1]
                )
            )

            W = raw_w.t().contiguous().clone().float() if is_conv1d else raw_w.clone().float()
            device = raw_w.device
            dtype = raw_w.dtype
            d_out, d_in = W.shape

            try:
                U, S, Vh = torch.linalg.svd(W, full_matrices=False)
                r = self._select_rank(S, d_in, d_out)
                sqrt_S = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S[:r], min=1e-12))

                new_layer = LowRankLinear(
                    in_features=d_in,
                    out_features=d_out,
                    rank=r,
                    bias=(base_mod.bias is not None),
                    device=device,
                    dtype=dtype,
                )

                # Assign factorized weights: W ≈ (U_r sqrt(S)) @ (sqrt(S) V_r^T)
                # U: [d_out, r], V: [d_in, r]
                new_layer.U.data = (U[:, :r] * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0)).to(dtype=dtype, device=device)
                new_layer.V.data = (Vh[:r, :].T * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0)).to(
                    dtype=dtype, device=device
                )

                if base_mod.bias is not None:
                    new_layer.bias.data.copy_(base_mod.bias.data)

                # Frobenius reconstruction error check
                W_rec = new_layer.weight.float()
                norm_orig = torch.norm(W, p="fro")
                rel_err = (torch.norm(W - W_rec, p="fro") / (norm_orig + 1e-8)).item()
                self.layer_errors[name] = rel_err

                if self.fallback_to_original and rel_err > self.max_error:
                    logger.warning(
                        "SoKA reconstruction error %.4f on %s exceeded threshold %.4f. Skipping.",
                        rel_err,
                        name,
                        self.max_error,
                    )
                    for p in module.parameters():
                        p.requires_grad = False
                    continue

                compressed_layer = new_layer
                # Preserve existing LoRA adapter weights if the source module has them
                if (
                    hasattr(module, "lora_A")
                    and hasattr(module, "lora_B")
                    and module.lora_A is not None
                    and module.lora_B is not None
                ):
                    src_lA = getattr(module.lora_A, "weight", module.lora_A)
                    src_lB = getattr(module.lora_B, "weight", module.lora_B)
                    if hasattr(new_layer, "lora_A") and new_layer.lora_A is not None:
                        if hasattr(src_lA, "data") and src_lA.shape == new_layer.lora_A.shape:
                            new_layer.lora_A.data.copy_(src_lA.data)
                    if hasattr(new_layer, "lora_B") and new_layer.lora_B is not None:
                        if hasattr(src_lB, "data") and src_lB.shape == new_layer.lora_B.shape:
                            new_layer.lora_B.data.copy_(src_lB.data)

                if hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                    module.base_layer = compressed_layer  # put compressed layer inside wrapper
                    # module itself (LoRALinear wrapper) remains the replacement
                    new_module = module
                else:
                    new_module = compressed_layer
                if not hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                    if name == "":
                        self.model = new_module
                    else:
                        replace_module(self.model, name, new_module)
                self.compressed_layers.append(
                    {
                        "name": name,
                        "original_shape": (d_out, d_in),
                        "rank": r,
                        "error": rel_err,
                    }
                )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.debug("SVD decomposition error in %s: %s", name, e)
                for p in module.parameters():
                    p.requires_grad = False

        self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
        stats = self.get_compression_stats()
        stats.update(
            {
                "total_layers": len(self.compressed_layers),
                "method": "soka_low_rank_svd",
                "fixed_rank": self.rank,
                "energy_threshold": self.energy_threshold,
                "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
                "target_attention_only": self.target_attention_only,
                "fallback_to_original": self.fallback_to_original,
                "max_error": self.max_error,
            }
        )
        self.stats = stats
        return self.model, stats

class LowRankLinear(nn.Module):
    """
    Factorized Linear Layer executing as y = (x @ V) @ U^T + b.
    Reduces parameter storage from (d_in * d_out) to r * (d_in + d_out).
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        in_features: int,
        out_features: int,
        rank: int,
        bias: bool = True,
        device: torch.device | None = None,
        dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.in_features = in_features
        self.out_features = out_features
        self.rank = max(1, min(rank, in_features, out_features))

        # V: [in_features, rank] -> maps x to bottleneck
        # U: [out_features, rank] -> maps bottleneck to output
        self.V = nn.Parameter(torch.empty((in_features, self.rank), device=device, dtype=dtype))
        self.U = nn.Parameter(torch.empty((out_features, self.rank), device=device, dtype=dtype))

        if bias:
            self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(out_features, device=device, dtype=dtype))
        else:
            self.register_parameter("bias", None)

        nn.init.normal_(self.V, std=0.02)
        nn.init.normal_(self.U, std=0.02)

    @property
    def weight(self) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Reconstructed effective weight matrix for compatibility."""
        return torch.matmul(self.U, self.V.t().contiguous())

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        # x: [..., in_features]
        bottleneck = torch.matmul(x, self.V)  # [..., rank]
        out = torch.matmul(bottleneck, self.U.T)  # [..., out_features]
        if self.bias is not None:
            out = out + self.bias
        return out

@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("mgie_budget")
class MGIESVDBudgetCompressor(BaseCompressor):
    """
    MGIE-SVD Budget Compressor: Global Entropy-Proportional Rank Allocation.
    """

    # MGIE-BUDGET-FIX-01
    is_custom_attention: bool = False

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        total_rank_budget: int = 1000,
        rank: int | None = None,
        max_error: float = 0.50,
        fallback_to_original: bool = True,
        lora_r: int = 0,
        lora_alpha: float = 1.0,
        skip_attention_qkv: bool = False,
        target_attention_only: bool = False,
        min_rank: int = 4,
        target_modules: list[str] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(model, name="mgie_budget", **kwargs)
        cfg = kwargs.get("comp_config", kwargs.get("cfg"))

        if cfg is not None:
            total_rank_budget = _cfg_get(
                cfg,
                "total_rank_budget",
                _cfg_get(cfg, "rank_budget", total_rank_budget),
            )
            rank = _cfg_get(cfg, "mgie_rank", _cfg_get(cfg, "rank", rank))
            max_error = _cfg_get(cfg, "mgie_max_error", _cfg_get(cfg, "max_error", max_error))
            fallback_to_original = _cfg_get(
                cfg,
                "mgie_fallback_to_original",
                _cfg_get(cfg, "fallback_to_original", fallback_to_original),
            )
            lora_r = _cfg_get(cfg, "lora_r", lora_r)
            lora_alpha = _cfg_get(cfg, "lora_alpha", lora_alpha)
            skip_attention_qkv = _cfg_get(cfg, "skip_attention_qkv", skip_attention_qkv)
            target_attention_only = _cfg_get(cfg, "target_attention_only", target_attention_only)
            min_rank = _cfg_get(cfg, "min_rank", min_rank)

        if "rank" in kwargs and kwargs["rank"] is not None:
            rank = kwargs["rank"]

        self.total_rank_budget = max(1, int(total_rank_budget))
        self.rank = rank
        self.max_error = float(max_error)
        self.fallback_to_original = bool(fallback_to_original)
        self.lora_r = int(lora_r)
        self.lora_alpha = float(lora_alpha)
        self.skip_attention_qkv = bool(skip_attention_qkv)
        self.target_attention_only = bool(target_attention_only)
        self.min_rank = max(1, int(min_rank))
        self.target_modules = target_modules

        self.compressed_layers: list[str] = []
        self.fallback_layers: list[str] = []
        self.skipped_layers: list[str] = []
        self.layer_errors: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.layer_ranks: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.stats: dict[str, Any] = {}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _is_gqa_asymmetric(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        if not self.skip_attention_qkv:
            return False
        cfg = getattr(self.model, "config", None)
        num_heads = getattr(cfg, "num_attention_heads", None)
        num_kv_heads = getattr(cfg, "num_key_value_heads", None)
        if num_heads is not None and num_kv_heads is not None and num_kv_heads < num_heads:
            name_lower = name.lower()
            if any(
                p in name_lower
                for p in (
                    "q_proj",
                    "k_proj",
                    "v_proj",
                    "query",
                    "key",
                    "value",
                    "c_attn",
                )
            ):
                return True
        return False

    def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        # MGIE-BUDGET-FIX-07: skip already-compressed SVDLinear
        if isinstance(module, SVDLinear):
            return False
        name_l = name.lower()
        if any(
            k in name_l
            for k in (
                "classifier",
                "score",
                "lm_head",
                "pooler",
                "embedding",
                "layernorm",
                "rmsnorm",
                "batchnorm",
            )
        ):
            return False

        cls_name = module.__class__.__name__.lower()
        is_linear_like = (
            isinstance(module, nn.Linear)
            or "conv1d" in cls_name
            or hasattr(module, "nf")
            or hasattr(module, "base_layer")
        )
        if not is_linear_like:
            return False

        try:
            if not should_compress_linear(self.model, name):
                return False
        except Exception:
            pass

        if self._is_gqa_asymmetric(name, module):
            return False

        if self.target_attention_only:
            if not any(k in name_l for k in _ATTN_NAMES):
                return False

        if self.target_modules is None:
            return True
        return any(t in name for t in self.target_modules)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    @staticmethod
    def _compute_entropy(
        W: torch.Tensor,
    ) -> tuple[float, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Compute singular entropy on squared singular values (energy distribution).
        Returns (entropy, U, S, Vt) in FP32.
        """
        U, S, Vt = torch.linalg.svd(W.float(), full_matrices=False)
        energy = S**2
        total_energy = energy.sum()
        if total_energy <= 1e-12:
            return 0.0, U, S, Vt
        p = torch.clamp(energy / total_energy, min=1e-12, max=1.0)
        entropy = -torch.sum(p * torch.log(p)).item()
        return max(0.0, float(entropy)), U, S, Vt

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _allocate_ranks(
        self,
        entropies: list[float],
        max_ranks: list[int],
    ) -> list[int]:
        """
        Allocate ranks proportional to entropy, then enforce total_rank_budget
        (MGIE-BUDGET-FIX-06).
        """
        n = len(entropies)
        if n == 0:
            return []

        # Fallback if all entropies ≈ 0.
        total_ent = sum(max(e, 1e-4) for e in entropies)
        if total_ent <= 1e-9:
            per = max(1, self.total_rank_budget // max(1, n))
            return [max(1, min(per, mr)) for mr in max_ranks]

        # Initial allocation.
        ranks = []
        for e, mr in zip(entropies, max_ranks):
            frac = max(e, 1e-4) / total_ent
            r = int(round(frac * self.total_rank_budget))
            r = max(self.min_rank, min(r, mr))
            ranks.append(r)

        # Enforce budget: reduce the largest ranks first.
        # We never go below min_rank (or 1 if max_rank < min_rank).
        total = sum(ranks)
        while total > self.total_rank_budget:
            # pick the layer with the largest current rank that can be reduced
            candidates = [
                i for i in range(n) if ranks[i] > max(1, min(self.min_rank, max_ranks[i]))
            ]
            if not candidates:
                break
            idx = max(candidates, key=lambda i: ranks[i])
            ranks[idx] -= 1
            total = sum(ranks)

        # If under budget, try to increase ranks of layers with largest
        # entropy-per-bit deficit (simple heuristic: increase the layer with
        # the largest max_rank - rank, weighted by entropy).
        if total < self.total_rank_budget:
            order = sorted(
                range(n),
                key=lambda i: entropies[i] / max(1, ranks[i]),
                reverse=True,
            )
            while total < self.total_rank_budget:
                progressed = False
                for i in order:
                    if ranks[i] < max_ranks[i]:
                        ranks[i] += 1
                        total += 1
                        progressed = True
                        if total >= self.total_rank_budget:
                            break
                if not progressed:
                    break

        # Final clamp.
        ranks = [max(1, min(r, max_ranks[i])) for i, r in enumerate(ranks)]
        return ranks

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def compress(self, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
        self.compressed_layers = []
        self.fallback_layers = []
        self.skipped_layers = []
        self.layer_errors = {}
        self.layer_ranks = {}

        seen_weights: set[int] = set()

        total_orig_params = sum(p.numel() for p in self.model.parameters())

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 1. Collect target layers.
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        target_layers: list[tuple[str, nn.Module, nn.Module]] = []
        for name, module in list(self.model.named_modules()):
            if not self._is_target_module(name, module):
                continue
            base = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
            if not hasattr(base, "weight") or base.weight is None:
                continue
            w_id = id(base.weight)
            if w_id in seen_weights:
                self.skipped_layers.append(name)
                continue
            seen_weights.add(w_id)
            target_layers.append((name, module, base))

        if not target_layers:
            logger.warning("MGIE-Budget: no compressible linear layers found.")
            stats = self.get_compression_stats()
            stats.update(
                {
                    "num_compressed": 0,
                    "num_fallback": 0,
                    "num_skipped": len(self.skipped_layers),
                    "method": "mgie_budget",
                }
            )
            self.stats = stats
            return self.model, stats

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 2. Compute per-layer entropy and SVD.
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        layer_data: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        entropies: list[float] = []
        max_ranks: list[int] = []

        for name, module, target_layer in target_layers:
            raw_w = target_layer.weight.data
            cls_name = target_layer.__class__.__name__.lower()
            is_conv1d = "conv1d" in cls_name or hasattr(target_layer, "nf")

            W = raw_w.t().contiguous().clone().float() if is_conv1d else raw_w.clone().float()
            d_out, d_in = W.shape
            max_r = min(d_out, d_in)

            ent, U, S, Vt = self._compute_entropy(W)
            layer_data.append(
                {
                    "name": name,
                    "module": module,
                    "target_layer": target_layer,
                    "W": W,
                    "U": U,
                    "S": S,
                    "Vt": Vt,
                    "is_conv1d": is_conv1d,
                    "d_in": d_in,
                    "d_out": d_out,
                    "max_r": max_r,
                }
            )
            entropies.append(ent)
            max_ranks.append(max_r)

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 3. Allocate ranks (with budget enforcement).
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        if self.rank is not None:
            # Explicit rank overrides budget.
            for info in layer_data:
                info["rank"] = max(1, min(self.rank, info["max_r"]))
        else:
            ranks = self._allocate_ranks(entropies, max_ranks)
            for info, r in zip(layer_data, ranks):
                info["rank"] = max(1, min(r, info["max_r"]))

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 4. Apply compression.
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        for info in layer_data:
            name = info["name"]
            module = info["module"]
            target_layer = info["target_layer"]
            W = info["W"]
            U = info["U"]
            S = info["S"]
            Vt = info["Vt"]
            r = info["rank"]
            d_in = info["d_in"]
            d_out = info["d_out"]
            device = target_layer.weight.device
            dtype = target_layer.weight.dtype

            try:
                sqrt_S = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(S[:r], min=1e-12))
                U_r = (U[:, :r] * sqrt_S.unsqueeze(0)).to(device=device, dtype=dtype)
                V_r = (sqrt_S.unsqueeze(1) * Vt[:r, :]).to(device=device, dtype=dtype)

                W_approx = torch.nan_to_num(U_r @ V_r, nan=0.0)
                w_norm = torch.norm(W, p="fro").clamp_min(1e-12).item()
                err = (torch.norm(W.to(device) - W_approx, p="fro") / w_norm).item()
                self.layer_errors[name] = float(err)
                self.layer_ranks[name] = r

                if not math.isfinite(err) or err > self.max_error:
                    logger.warning(
                        "MGIE-Budget: reconstruction error %.4f on %s exceeded %.4f.",
                        err,
                        name,
                        self.max_error,
                    )
                    if self.fallback_to_original:
                        self.fallback_layers.append(name)
                        for p in module.parameters():
                            p.requires_grad = False
                        continue

                existing_lora_r = getattr(module, "r", getattr(module, "lora_r", 0))
                eff_lora_r = existing_lora_r if existing_lora_r > 0 else self.lora_r
                # MGIE-BUDGET-FIX-08: correct lora_alpha retrieval
                eff_lora_alpha = getattr(module, "lora_alpha", None)
                if eff_lora_alpha is None:
                    eff_lora_alpha = getattr(module, "alpha", self.lora_alpha)
                eff_lora_alpha = float(eff_lora_alpha)

                svd_layer = SVDLinear(
                    in_features=d_in,
                    out_features=d_out,
                    rank=r,
                    bias=(target_layer.bias is not None),
                    dtype=dtype,
                    device=device,
                    lora_r=eff_lora_r,
                    lora_alpha=eff_lora_alpha,
                )

                # MGIE-BUDGET-FIX-09: verify API availability
                if not hasattr(svd_layer, "set_low_rank_factors"):
                    raise AttributeError(
                        "SVDLinear does not implement set_low_rank_factors; "
                        "MGIE-Budget requires an updated aa_svd_compressor."
                    )
                svd_layer.set_low_rank_factors(U_r, V_r)

                # MGIE-BUDGET-FIX-05: bias copy under no_grad.
                if target_layer.bias is not None and svd_layer.bias is not None:
                    with torch.no_grad():
                        svd_layer.bias.data.copy_(
                            target_layer.bias.data.to(
                                device=svd_layer.bias.device,
                                dtype=svd_layer.bias.dtype,
                            )
                        )

                # Preserve pre-existing LoRA adapter parameters if wrapped.
                if (
                    hasattr(module, "lora_A")
                    and hasattr(module, "lora_B")
                    and svd_layer.lora_A is not None
                    and svd_layer.lora_B is not None
                ):
                    with torch.no_grad():
                        src_A = (
                            module.lora_A.weight.data
                            if hasattr(module.lora_A, "weight")
                            else module.lora_A.data
                        )
                        src_B = (
                            module.lora_B.weight.data
                            if hasattr(module.lora_B, "weight")
                            else module.lora_B.data
                        )
                        if (
                            src_A.shape == svd_layer.lora_A.shape
                            and src_B.shape == svd_layer.lora_B.shape
                        ):
                            svd_layer.lora_A.copy_(
                                src_A.to(
                                    svd_layer.lora_A.device,
                                    dtype=svd_layer.lora_A.dtype,
                                )
                            )
                            svd_layer.lora_B.copy_(
                                src_B.to(
                                    svd_layer.lora_B.device,
                                    dtype=svd_layer.lora_B.dtype,
                                )
                            )
                    svd_layer.lora_A.requires_grad = True
                    svd_layer.lora_B.requires_grad = True

                # MGIE-BUDGET-FIX-02: preserve LoRA wrapper.
                if hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                    module.base_layer = svd_layer
                else:
                    replace_module(self.model, name, svd_layer)

                self.compressed_layers.append(name)

            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning("MGIE-Budget: failed on %s: %s", name, e)
                self.fallback_layers.append(name)
                self.layer_errors[name] = 1.0
                for p in module.parameters():
                    p.requires_grad = False

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 5. Forward sanity check (MGIE-BUDGET-FIX-03)
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        forward_check_success = True
        try:
            with torch.no_grad():
                dev = next(self.model.parameters(), torch.tensor(0.0)).device
                dummy = torch.randint(0, 100, (1, 8), device=dev, dtype=torch.long)
                try:
                    self.model(input_ids=dummy)
                except Exception:
                    try:
                        self.model(dummy)
                    except Exception:
                        cfg = getattr(self.model, "config", None)
                        hidden = getattr(cfg, "hidden_size", None) if cfg else None
                        if hidden is None:
                            first_lin = next(
                                (m for m in self.model.modules() if isinstance(m, nn.Linear)),
                                None,
                            )
                            hidden = getattr(first_lin, "in_features", 8)
                        dt = next(self.model.parameters()).dtype
                        dummy_feat = torch.randn(1, 8, hidden, device=dev, dtype=dt)
                        self.model(dummy_feat)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("MGIE-Budget forward sanity check failed: %s", e)
            forward_check_success = False

        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        # 6. Stats (MGIE-BUDGET-FIX-04)
        # ------------------------------------------------------------------
        try:
            self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
        except Exception:
            self._compressed_params = sum(p.numel() for p in self.model.parameters())

        eff_ratio = self._compressed_params / max(1, total_orig_params)

        avg_err = (
            sum(self.layer_errors.values()) / max(1, len(self.layer_errors))
            if self.layer_errors
            else 0.0
        )

        allocated_ranks = [self.layer_ranks.get(name, 0) for name in self.layer_ranks]
        total_allocated = sum(allocated_ranks)

        stats = self.get_compression_stats()
        stats.update(
            {
                "compressed_layers": self.compressed_layers,
                "fallback_layers": self.fallback_layers,
                "skipped_layers": self.skipped_layers,
                "num_compressed": len(self.compressed_layers),
                "num_fallback": len(self.fallback_layers),
                "num_skipped": len(self.skipped_layers),
                "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
                "layer_ranks": self.layer_ranks,
                "avg_reconstruction_error": avg_err,
                "max_error": self.max_error,
                "fallback_to_original": self.fallback_to_original,
                "total_rank_budget": self.total_rank_budget,
                "total_allocated_rank": total_allocated,
                "rank_budget_utilization_pct": round(
                    100.0 * total_allocated / max(1, self.total_rank_budget), 2
                ),
                "total_params_before": total_orig_params,
                "total_params_after": self._compressed_params,
                "effective_parameter_ratio": round(eff_ratio, 4),
                "lora_r": self.lora_r,
                "lora_alpha": self.lora_alpha,
                "forward_check_success": forward_check_success,
                "method": "mgie_budget",
            }
        )
        self.stats = stats
        return self.model, stats

@COMPRESSOR_REGISTRY.register("mlorq_compressor")
class MLoRQCompressor(BaseCompressor):
    """
    MLoRQ Compressor: Multi-Layer Optimal Rank and Quantization under Memory Budget.
    """

    is_custom_attention: bool = False  # MLR-FIX-01

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        total_memory_budget_mb: float = 500,
        bits_candidates: list[int] | None = None,
        max_error: float = 0.50,
        fallback_to_original: bool = True,
        lora_r: int = 0,
        lora_alpha: float = 1.0,
        skip_attention_qkv: bool = False,
        target_attention_only: bool = False,
        min_rank: int = 4,
        target_modules: list[str] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(model, name="mlorq", **kwargs)
        cfg = kwargs.get("comp_config", kwargs.get("cfg"))
        if cfg is not None:
            total_memory_budget_mb = _cfg_get(
                cfg,
                "mlorq_budget_mb",
                _cfg_get(cfg, "total_memory_budget_mb", total_memory_budget_mb),
            )
            bits_candidates = _cfg_get(
                cfg,
                "mlorq_bits_candidates",
                _cfg_get(cfg, "bits_candidates", bits_candidates),
            )
            max_error = _cfg_get(cfg, "mlorq_max_error", _cfg_get(cfg, "max_error", max_error))
            fallback_to_original = _cfg_get(
                cfg,
                "mlorq_fallback_to_original",
                _cfg_get(cfg, "fallback_to_original", fallback_to_original),
            )
            lora_r = _cfg_get(cfg, "lora_r", lora_r)
            lora_alpha = _cfg_get(cfg, "lora_alpha", lora_alpha)
            skip_attention_qkv = _cfg_get(cfg, "skip_attention_qkv", skip_attention_qkv)
            target_attention_only = _cfg_get(cfg, "target_attention_only", target_attention_only)
            min_rank = _cfg_get(cfg, "min_rank", min_rank)

        self.total_budget_bits = float(total_memory_budget_mb) * 8 * 1024 * 1024  # bits
        self.bits_candidates = sorted(set(int(b) for b in (bits_candidates or [4, 8])))
        self.max_error = float(max_error)
        self.fallback_to_original = bool(fallback_to_original)
        self.lora_r = int(lora_r)
        self.lora_alpha = float(lora_alpha)
        self.skip_attention_qkv = bool(skip_attention_qkv)
        self.target_attention_only = bool(target_attention_only)
        self.min_rank = max(1, int(min_rank))
        self.target_modules = target_modules

        self.compressed_layers: list[str] = []
        self.fallback_layers: list[str] = []
        self.skipped_layers: list[str] = []
        self.layer_errors: dict[str, float] = {}
        self.layer_ranks: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.layer_bits: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.stats: dict[str, Any] = {}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _is_gqa_asymmetric(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        if not self.skip_attention_qkv:
            return False
        cfg = getattr(self.model, "config", None)
        num_heads = getattr(cfg, "num_attention_heads", None)
        num_kv_heads = getattr(cfg, "num_key_value_heads", None)
        if num_heads is not None and num_kv_heads is not None and num_kv_heads < num_heads:
            name_lower = name.lower()
            if any(
                p in name_lower
                for p in (
                    "q_proj",
                    "k_proj",
                    "v_proj",
                    "query",
                    "key",
                    "value",
                    "c_attn",
                )
            ):
                return True
        return False

    def _is_target_module(self, name: str, module: nn.Module) -> bool:
        name_l = name.lower()
        if any(
            k in name_l
            for k in (
                "classifier",
                "score",
                "lm_head",
                "pooler",
                "embedding",
                "layernorm",
                "rmsnorm",
                "batchnorm",
            )
        ):
            return False
        if isinstance(module, (nn.LayerNorm, nn.RMSNorm, nn.Embedding, MLoRQLoRALinear)):
            return False

        cls_name = module.__class__.__name__.lower()
        is_linear_like = (
            isinstance(module, nn.Linear)
            or "conv1d" in cls_name
            or hasattr(module, "nf")
            or hasattr(module, "base_layer")
        )
        if not is_linear_like:
            return False

        try:
            if not should_compress_linear(self.model, name):
                return False
        except Exception:
            pass

        if self._is_gqa_asymmetric(name, module):
            return False

        if self.target_attention_only and not any(k in name_l for k in _ATTN_NAMES):
            return False

        if self.target_modules is None:
            return True
        return any(t in name for t in self.target_modules)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    @staticmethod
    def _quantize_float(t: torch.Tensor, bits: int) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Non-packed quantization for error estimation."""
        if bits >= 32:
            return t.float()
        tf = t.float()
        max_abs = tf.abs().max().clamp_min(1e-8)
        if bits >= 8:
            scale = max_abs / 127.0
            return torch.round(tf / scale).clamp(-128, 127) * scale
        qmax = (1 << (bits - 1)) - 1
        scale = max_abs / float(qmax)
        return torch.round(tf / scale).clamp(-qmax - 1, qmax) * scale

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _generate_candidates(self, W: torch.Tensor) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Generate (rank, bits, error, cost_bits, U, S, Vt) candidates for a weight."""
        out_f, in_f = W.shape
        max_rank = min(out_f, in_f)

        # Randomized SVD for large matrices (MLR-FIX-09)
        q = min(max_rank + 10, max_rank)
        if W.numel() > 1_000_000:
            try:
                U, S, V = torch.svd_lowrank(W.float(), q=q, niter=4)
                Vt = V.t().contiguous()
            except Exception:
                U, S, Vt = torch.linalg.svd(W.float(), full_matrices=False)
        else:
            U, S, Vt = torch.linalg.svd(W.float(), full_matrices=False)

        # Rank list (unique, <= max_rank)
        ranks = set()
        ranks.add(min(self.min_rank, max_rank))
        for frac in (8, 4, 2):
            r = max(self.min_rank, max_rank // frac)
            if r <= max_rank:
                ranks.add(r)
        ranks.add(max_rank)
        ranks = sorted(r for r in ranks if r >= 1 and r <= max_rank)

        candidates = []
        for bits in self.bits_candidates:
            for r in ranks:
                if r > U.shape[1]:
                    continue
                U_r = U[:, :r]
                S_r = S[:r]
                Vt_r = Vt[:r, :]

                U_q = self._quantize_float(U_r, bits)
                S_q = self._quantize_float(S_r, bits)
                Vt_q = self._quantize_float(Vt_r, bits)

                W_rec = U_q @ torch.diag(S_q) @ Vt_q
                w_norm = torch.norm(W, p="fro").clamp_min(1e-12).item()
                err = float((torch.norm(W - W_rec, p="fro") / w_norm).item())

                # cost in bits for packed storage
                cost_bits = (out_f * r + r * in_f + r) * bits
                candidates.append(
                    {
                        "rank": r,
                        "bits": bits,
                        "error": err,
                        "cost_bits": cost_bits,
                        "U": U_r,
                        "S": S_r,
                        "Vt": Vt_r,
                    }
                )
        candidates.sort(key=lambda c: c["cost_bits"])
        return candidates

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def compress(self, **kwargs: Any) -> tuple[nn.Module, dict[str, Any]]:
        self.compressed_layers = []
        self.fallback_layers = []
        self.skipped_layers = []
        self.layer_errors = {}
        self.layer_ranks = {}
        self.layer_bits = {}
        seen_weights: set[int] = set()

        # ---------- 1. Collect target layers ----------
        layer_infos: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        total_orig_bits = 0

        for name, module in list(self.model.named_modules()):
            if not self._is_target_module(name, module):
                continue

            base = getattr(module, "base_layer", module)
            w = getattr(base, "weight", None)
            if w is None:
                continue
            w_id = id(w)
            if w_id in seen_weights:
                self.skipped_layers.append(name)
                continue
            seen_weights.add(w_id)

            raw_w = w.data
            orig_bits = raw_w.numel() * raw_w.element_size() * 8
            total_orig_bits += orig_bits

            cls_name = base.__class__.__name__.lower()
            is_conv1d = "conv1d" in cls_name or hasattr(base, "nf")
            W = raw_w.t().contiguous().clone().float() if is_conv1d else raw_w.clone().float()

            layer_infos.append(
                {
                    "name": name,
                    "module": module,
                    "base": base,
                    "W": W,
                    "shape": W.shape,
                    "is_conv1d": is_conv1d,
                    "device": raw_w.device,
                    "dtype": raw_w.dtype,
                    "orig_bits": orig_bits,
                }
            )

        if not layer_infos:
            logger.warning("MLoRQ: no target layers found.")
            stats = self.get_compression_stats()
            stats.update({"num_compressed": 0, "method": "mlorq"})
            self.stats = stats
            return self.model, stats

        # ---------- 2. Generate candidates ----------
        for info in layer_infos:
            cands = self._generate_candidates(info["W"])
            # Filter by max_error
            valid = [c for c in cands if c["error"] <= self.max_error]
            if not valid:
                # fallback original
                info["candidates"] = []
                info["chosen"] = None
                info["current_cost"] = info["orig_bits"]
                info["current_error"] = 0.0
            else:
                info["candidates"] = valid
                info["chosen"] = valid[0]  # cheapest valid
                info["current_cost"] = valid[0]["cost_bits"]
                info["current_error"] = valid[0]["error"]

        # ---------- 3. Greedy budget allocation (MLR-FIX-04) ----------
        total_cost = sum(info["current_cost"] for info in layer_infos)
        budget = self.total_budget_bits

        # Downgrade if over budget
        while total_cost > budget:
            best_info = None
            best_ratio = float("inf")
            best_new = None
            for info in layer_infos:
                if info["chosen"] is None:
                    continue
                # find cheaper candidate than current
                cheaper = [c for c in info["candidates"] if c["cost_bits"] < info["current_cost"]]
                if not cheaper:
                    continue
                # choose the cheapest cheaper candidate? Actually we want the one with smallest error increase per bit saved.
                # We can evaluate each cheaper candidate, but for simplicity pick the next cheaper (max cost < current).
                next_cheaper = max(cheaper, key=lambda c: c["cost_bits"])
                delta_cost = info["current_cost"] - next_cheaper["cost_bits"]
                delta_err = next_cheaper["error"] - info["current_error"]
                if delta_cost <= 0:
                    continue
                ratio = delta_err / delta_cost
                if ratio < best_ratio:
                    best_ratio = ratio
                    best_info = info
                    best_new = next_cheaper
            if best_info is None:
                break
            # apply downgrade
            best_info["chosen"] = best_new
            best_info["current_cost"] = best_new["cost_bits"]
            best_info["current_error"] = best_new["error"]
            total_cost = sum(info["current_cost"] for info in layer_infos)

        # Upgrade if under budget
        while total_cost < budget:
            best_info = None
            best_ratio = -1.0
            best_new = None
            for info in layer_infos:
                if info["chosen"] is None:
                    continue
                # find more expensive candidate
                more = [c for c in info["candidates"] if c["cost_bits"] > info["current_cost"]]
                if not more:
                    continue
                next_more = min(more, key=lambda c: c["cost_bits"])
                delta_cost = next_more["cost_bits"] - info["current_cost"]
                delta_err = info["current_error"] - next_more["error"]
                if delta_cost <= 0:
                    continue
                if total_cost + delta_cost > budget:
                    continue
                ratio = delta_err / delta_cost
                if ratio > best_ratio:
                    best_ratio = ratio
                    best_info = info
                    best_new = next_more
            if best_info is None:
                break
            best_info["chosen"] = best_new
            best_info["current_cost"] = best_new["cost_bits"]
            best_info["current_error"] = best_new["error"]
            total_cost = sum(info["current_cost"] for info in layer_infos)

        # ---------- 4. Apply chosen candidates ----------
        total_comp_bytes = 0
        for info in layer_infos:
            name = info["name"]
            module = info["module"]
            chosen = info["chosen"]

            if chosen is None:
                # fallback original
                self.fallback_layers.append(name)
                total_comp_bytes += info["orig_bits"] // 8
                continue

            try:
                new_layer = MLoRQLoRALinear.from_linear(
                    module,
                    U=chosen["U"],
                    S=chosen["S"],
                    Vt=chosen["Vt"],
                    bits=chosen["bits"],
                    lora_r=self.lora_r,
                    lora_alpha=self.lora_alpha,
                )
                # MLR-FIX-05: preserve wrapper
                if hasattr(module, "base_layer"):
                    module.base_layer = new_layer
                else:
                    replace_module(self.model, name, new_layer)

                self.compressed_layers.append(name)
                self.layer_errors[name] = float(chosen["error"])
                self.layer_ranks[name] = int(chosen["rank"])
                self.layer_bits[name] = int(chosen["bits"])
                total_comp_bytes += new_layer.storage_bytes()
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning("MLoRQ: failed on %s: %s", name, e)
                self.fallback_layers.append(name)
                total_comp_bytes += info["orig_bits"] // 8

        # ---------- 5. Forward sanity check (MLR-FIX-06) ----------
        forward_check_success = True
        try:
            with torch.no_grad():
                dev = next(self.model.parameters(), torch.tensor(0.0)).device
                dummy = torch.randint(0, 100, (1, 8), device=dev, dtype=torch.long)
                try:
                    self.model(input_ids=dummy)
                except Exception:
                    try:
                        self.model(dummy)
                    except Exception:
                        cfg = getattr(self.model, "config", None)
                        hidden = getattr(cfg, "hidden_size", None) if cfg else None
                        if hidden is None:
                            first_lin = next(
                                (m for m in self.model.modules() if isinstance(m, nn.Linear)),
                                None,
                            )
                            hidden = getattr(first_lin, "in_features", 8)
                        dt = next(self.model.parameters()).dtype
                        dummy_feat = torch.randn(1, 8, hidden, device=dev, dtype=dt)
                        self.model(dummy_feat)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning("MLoRQ forward sanity check failed: %s", e)
            forward_check_success = False

        # ---------- 6. Stats ----------
        try:
            self._compressed_params = self._count_params(self.model)
        except Exception:
            self._compressed_params = sum(p.numel() for p in self.model.parameters())

        avg_err = (
            sum(self.layer_errors.values()) / max(1, len(self.layer_errors))
            if self.layer_errors
            else 0.0
        )
        storage_ratio = (
            total_orig_bits / 8 / max(1, total_comp_bytes) if total_comp_bytes > 0 else 1.0
        )
        stats = self.get_compression_stats()
        stats.update(
            {
                "compressed_layers": self.compressed_layers,
                "fallback_layers": self.fallback_layers,
                "skipped_layers": self.skipped_layers,
                "num_compressed": len(self.compressed_layers),
                "num_fallback": len(self.fallback_layers),
                "num_skipped": len(self.skipped_layers),
                "layer_errors": self.layer_errors,
                "layer_ranks": self.layer_ranks,
                "layer_bits": self.layer_bits,
                "avg_reconstruction_error": avg_err,
                "max_error": self.max_error,
                "fallback_to_original": self.fallback_to_original,
                "total_budget_bits": self.total_budget_bits,
                "total_used_bits": total_cost,
                "budget_utilization_pct": round(
                    100.0 * total_cost / max(1, self.total_budget_bits), 2
                ),
                "orig_storage_bytes": total_orig_bits // 8,
                "comp_storage_bytes": total_comp_bytes,
                "storage_compression_ratio": round(storage_ratio, 3),
                "storage_reduction_pct": round(
                    100.0 * (1.0 - total_comp_bytes / max(1, total_orig_bits // 8)), 2
                ),
                "forward_check_success": forward_check_success,
                "method": "mlorq",
            }
        )
        self.stats = stats
        return self.model, stats

class MLoRQLoRALinear(nn.Module):
    """
    Low-rank quantized linear layer:

        y = (x @ Vt) * S @ U^T + bias + LoRA(x)

    where U, S, Vt are stored as PACKED int8 tensors with per-tensor scales.
    """

    is_custom_attention: bool = False  # MLR-FIX-01

    def __init__(
        self,
        in_features: int,
        out_features: int,
        rank: int,
        bits: int,
        U_packed: torch.Tensor,
        U_scale: torch.Tensor,
        U_shape: torch.Size,
        S_packed: torch.Tensor,
        S_scale: torch.Tensor,
        S_shape: torch.Size,
        Vt_packed: torch.Tensor,
        Vt_scale: torch.Tensor,
        Vt_shape: torch.Size,
        bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        lora_r: int = 0,
        lora_alpha: float = 1.0,
        device: torch.device | None = None,
        dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.in_features = int(in_features)
        self.out_features = int(out_features)
        self.nf = self.out_features
        self.rank = int(rank)
        self.bits = int(bits)
        self.lora_r = int(lora_r)
        self.lora_alpha = float(lora_alpha)
        self.scaling = (self.lora_alpha / self.lora_r) if self.lora_r > 0 else 1.0

        target_device = device if device is not None else U_packed.device
        target_dtype = dtype if dtype is not None else torch.float32

        self.register_buffer("U_packed", U_packed.to(target_device), persistent=True)
        self.register_buffer(
            "U_scale", U_scale.to(target_device, dtype=torch.float32), persistent=True
        )
        self.register_buffer("S_packed", S_packed.to(target_device), persistent=True)
        self.register_buffer(
            "S_scale", S_scale.to(target_device, dtype=torch.float32), persistent=True
        )
        self.register_buffer("Vt_packed", Vt_packed.to(target_device), persistent=True)
        self.register_buffer(
            "Vt_scale", Vt_scale.to(target_device, dtype=torch.float32), persistent=True
        )

        self.U_shape = tuple(U_shape)
        self.S_shape = tuple(S_shape)
        self.Vt_shape = tuple(Vt_shape)

        if bias is not None:
            self.bias = nn.Parameter(
                bias.to(device=target_device, dtype=target_dtype),
                requires_grad=False,
            )
        else:
            self.register_parameter("bias", None)

        if self.lora_r > 0:
            self.lora_A = nn.Parameter(
                torch.empty(
                    (self.lora_r, self.in_features),
                    dtype=torch.float32,
                    device=target_device,
                )
            )
            self.lora_B = nn.Parameter(
                torch.zeros(
                    (self.out_features, self.lora_r),
                    dtype=torch.float32,
                    device=target_device,
                )
            )
            nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.lora_A, a=math.sqrt(5))
        else:
            self.register_parameter("lora_A", None)
            self.register_parameter("lora_B", None)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _dequantize(self, dtype: torch.dtype, device: torch.device):
        U = _dequantize_packed(self.U_packed, self.bits, self.U_scale, self.U_shape, device, dtype)
        S = _dequantize_packed(self.S_packed, self.bits, self.S_scale, self.S_shape, device, dtype)
        Vt = _dequantize_packed(
            self.Vt_packed, self.bits, self.Vt_scale, self.Vt_shape, device, dtype
        )
        return U, S, Vt

    @property
    def weight(self) -> torch.Tensor:
        dtype = self.U_scale.dtype
        device = self.U_scale.device
        U, S, Vt = self._dequantize(dtype, device)
        return (U * S.unsqueeze(0)) @ Vt

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        U, S, Vt = self._dequantize(x.dtype, x.device)
        # (B, in) @ (in, r) -> (B, r)
        x_v = F.linear(x, Vt)
        x_v = x_v * S
        out = F.linear(x_v, U)
        if self.bias is not None:
            out = out + self.bias.to(dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
        if self.lora_r > 0 and self.lora_A is not None and self.lora_B is not None:
            out = out + self.scaling * F.linear(F.linear(x.float(), self.lora_A), self.lora_B).to(
                out.dtype
            )
        return out

    def storage_bytes(self) -> int:
        total = 0
        for name, buf in self.named_buffers():
            if buf is not None:
                total += buf.numel() * buf.element_size()
        if self.bias is not None:
            total += self.bias.numel() * self.bias.element_size()
        if self.lora_A is not None:
            total += self.lora_A.numel() * self.lora_A.element_size()
        if self.lora_B is not None:
            total += self.lora_B.numel() * self.lora_B.element_size()
        return total

    @classmethod
    def from_linear(
        cls,
        linear: nn.Module,
        U: torch.Tensor,
        S: torch.Tensor,
        Vt: torch.Tensor,
        bits: int,
        lora_r: int = 0,
        lora_alpha: float = 1.0,
    ) -> MLoRQLoRALinear:
        base_layer = getattr(linear, "base_layer", linear)
        bias = base_layer.bias.detach() if getattr(base_layer, "bias", None) is not None else None
        in_features = int(getattr(base_layer, "in_features", Vt.shape[1]))
        out_features = int(getattr(base_layer, "out_features", U.shape[0]))
        rank = int(min(U.shape[1], Vt.shape[0], S.numel()))

        # quantize + pack
        U_packed, U_scale, U_shape = _quantize_packed(U, bits)
        S_packed, S_scale, S_shape = _quantize_packed(S, bits)
        Vt_packed, Vt_scale, Vt_shape = _quantize_packed(Vt, bits)

        existing_lora_r = getattr(linear, "r", getattr(linear, "lora_r", 0))
        eff_lora_r = existing_lora_r if existing_lora_r > 0 else lora_r
        eff_lora_alpha = getattr(linear, "lora_alpha", getattr(linear, "alpha", lora_alpha))

        layer = cls(
            in_features=in_features,
            out_features=out_features,
            rank=rank,
            bits=bits,
            U_packed=U_packed,
            U_scale=U_scale,
            U_shape=U_shape,
            S_packed=S_packed,
            S_scale=S_scale,
            S_shape=S_shape,
            Vt_packed=Vt_packed,
            Vt_scale=Vt_scale,
            Vt_shape=Vt_shape,
            bias=bias,
            lora_r=eff_lora_r,
            lora_alpha=eff_lora_alpha,
            device=U.device,
            dtype=U.dtype,
        )

        # Preserve existing LoRA weights if present
        if (
            hasattr(linear, "lora_A")
            and hasattr(linear, "lora_B")
            and layer.lora_A is not None
            and layer.lora_B is not None
        ):
            with torch.no_grad():
                src_A = (
                    linear.lora_A.weight.data
                    if hasattr(linear.lora_A, "weight")
                    else linear.lora_A.data
                )
                src_B = (
                    linear.lora_B.weight.data
                    if hasattr(linear.lora_B, "weight")
                    else linear.lora_B.data
                )
                if src_A.shape == layer.lora_A.shape and src_B.shape == layer.lora_B.shape:
                    layer.lora_A.copy_(src_A.to(layer.lora_A.device, dtype=layer.lora_A.dtype))
                    layer.lora_B.copy_(src_B.to(layer.lora_B.device, dtype=layer.lora_B.dtype))
            layer.lora_A.requires_grad = True
            layer.lora_B.requires_grad = True

        return layer
